exposure: Orientation to female community health volunteers (FCHVs) on postpartum family planning
outcome: FCHV knowledge of postpartum family planning
Postpartum mothers receiving counseling from FCHVs
Sustainability of community-based and hospital-based postpartum family planning services
cohort: The study included female community health volunteers (FCHVs), postpartum mothers, and health providers in Morang district, Nepal.
finding: At one year post-intervention, FCHVs' knowledge and community-based postpartum family planning activities remained higher than pre-intervention levels, although they showed a decline compared to the immediate post-intervention period.
mod_finding: One finding indicated a significant improvement in FCHV knowledge that mothers who undergo cesarean section can use a postpartum intra-uterine device (PPIUD).
